messages.content: You are a careful, fair evaluator.

You are grading a support assistant's reply for Northwind Outdoor (an outdoor-gear and bike store). Judge a SINGLE failure mode only and ignore every other way the reply might be good or bad.

FAILURE MODE: MISSED REQUIRED FACT (missing_required_fact, NO-CONTEXT ablation)
Definition: the reply fails to convey a key fact the customer explicitly asked about, or a fact the resolved answer depends on. A factual error, a missing required number, a missing required confirmation, or omitting the core answer = FAIL. Correct and complete coverage of every required fact = PASS.

IMPORTANT (ablation): NO handbook context is provided for this one. You can only see that a context section existed, but NOT its text. Judge the missed-fact mode using only the ticket and the reply (e.g. facts the reply itself must contain and its internal consistency).

Grade ONLY this failure mode for the reply below.

--- TICKET ---
Hello, I am writing to ask about your discount rules before I buy anything. I am a student and also in the military. I want to know if I can get the 10% discount for both groups or just one? The website says verified students and military personnel receive a permanent 10% discount, but I am not sure how to combine them. Also, I see some items are on clearance. You say these sales last exactly 14 days and offer a minimum 25% discount. Does this 25% apply to all clearance items? I want to be sure I am not missing a better deal. I am a bit confused because I am not native English speaker and the rules are hard for me to understand. Please tell me if I can use my student ID and military ID together for the 10% off. And please confirm if the 14-day clearance period is fixed or if it can change. I want to buy a bike and some camping gear soon, so I need to know the exact rules. Thank you for your help. I look forward to your answer.

--- HANDBOOK CONTEXT ---
(section ids were recalled but their text is intentionally withheld in this ablation)

--- ASSISTANT REPLY ---
Hello! I understand the rules can be confusing, especially when trying to combine different benefits. I will answer your questions strictly based on the Northwind Outdoor handbook excerpts provided.

**1. Can you combine the Student and Military discounts?**
No, you cannot combine these discounts to get 20% off. The handbook states that verified students, active-duty military personnel, and first responders are eligible for a **permanent 10% discount** on all regular-priced items [discounts]. It does not state that these discounts are cumulative or stackable. Since both groups receive the same 10% benefit, you would only receive the 10% discount once, regardless of whether you verify as a student, a military member, or both. You must complete the verification process through the third-party partner service to activate this benefit on your account [discounts].

**2. Does the 25% clearance discount apply to all clearance items?**
The handbook states that during clearance periods, "all eligible inventory is marked down by a minimum of 25%" [discounts]. This means the discount applies to items that are designated as "eligible inventory" for the clearance sale. It does not explicitly guarantee that *every single item* in the store is on clearance, but any item marked as part of the clearance sale will have at least a 25% reduction.

**3. Is the 14-day clearance period fixed?**
Yes, the handbook specifies that these clearance periods "occur for exactly 14 days in January and July" [discounts]. This indicates the duration is fixed at 14 days for those specific months.

**4. Important Restrictions for Your Purchase**
Since you plan to buy a bike and camping gear, please note the following critical rules from the handbook:

*   **No Combining Discounts:** Clearance discounts "cannot be combined with any other promotional codes or loyalty rewards" [discounts]. This means if you buy an item during the 14-day clearance sale, you **cannot** also apply your 10% student/military discount to that specific item. You must choose which discount applies to each item.
*   **Bundle Savings:** If you are buying a tent, sleeping bag, and camp stove together, you can get a 15% bundle discount [discounts]. However, this promotion "does not apply to clearance items" [discounts]. So, if any of those three items are on clearance, you cannot use the 15% bundle discount.
*   **Timing:** You must complete your purchase within the 14-day window to secure the reduced price, as items revert to standard retail value immediately after the period ends [discounts].

**Summary for your purchase:**
*   If you buy **regular-priced** items, you can use your 10% student/military discount [discounts].
*   If you buy **clearance** items, you get the minimum 25% off, but you **cannot** use your 10% student/military discount on those items [discounts].
*   You cannot stack the 10% discount with the 25% clearance discount [discounts].

I hope this clarifies the rules for you. If you need further assistance or have questions about specific items, I can offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent.

--- GRADING EXAMPLES ---
